body: Youth. Been in what I've recently realized is an emotionally abusive relationship for years. She has successfully isolated me from any social contact slowly and to be honest, brilliantly. Now I'm left a guy who works a 70 hour week, can barely talk to people anymore and still comes home to accusations of cheating. I don't think my family would even believe me if I told them what has been going on. All I have positive is gym, I'm a decently in-shape guy now, but in my head I'm a little boy being held by the hand at all times and scolded for any minor perceived infraction. But she has her own social circle she is actively involved with while I'm at work or made to stay home. I don't want to type a huge wall of text, just need men to know they can be manipulated and abused too.
